messages:
sarah-hr: Quick Q — what's the cutoff date for submitting promotion packets if we want comp changes to hit in the FYQ2 payroll?

--

djensen: Hi! The operational cutoff for manager-submitted packets is 2026-05-10 EOD. That gets you into the Q2 comp cycle for effective pay on 2026-06-01. :calendar:

laura-eng: Is that the same for IC-level regrades (level changes without comp bump)? We had one promotion in April and we weren't sure if level change flows separately.

eli-manager: For promotions that only change title/level (no comp), you can still submit after cutoff but try to do it before 05/24 so it appears on org charts for mid-year reviews. Compensation approvals are tied to the cycle dates djensen mentioned.

djensen: To clarify: two parallel approvals — leveling (manager + skip-level + L4 review) and comp (manager + comp-partner + comp-committee). Both must be complete for a salary change to be executed in the payroll cycle. Level-only updates don't wait for comp committee.

sarah-hr: Thanks. What's the required manager packet? Link or checklist?

djensen: Use the Promotion Request form: https://redwood.internal/hr/forms/promo-request (internal). Required fields: current title/level, proposed title/level, justification (3 bullets), recent 2 peer feedback excerpts, manager calibration note. Attach CV/IC growth plan if available.

laura-eng: Can we add a temporary spot bonus instead of a salary change if comp committee is delayed? We have retention risk.

djensen: Spot bonuses are evaluated separately by comp-partners. If urgent, file the promo packet AND submit a Spot Bonus request (link in form footer). Spot bonus decisions are faster (~2 weeks) but not guaranteed.

eli-manager: One operational ask — if you expect a comp uplift >20% at promotion, flag it in the packet and ping comp-partner. Larger increases need exec sign-off and take longer.

comp-bot: [automated] Reminder: Comp committee meeting scheduled 2026-05-18. All packets marked "ready for review" by 2026-05-10 will be considered.

sarah-hr: Does the system support retro pay if approvals finalize after payroll cutoff?

djensen: Yes — retro is handled automatically if approvals come in within 30 days after the effective date. Payroll posts retro adjustments on the next paycheck cycle. Note: retro adjustments require final comp approval and documented effective date in the packet.

laura-eng: Are there hard band constraints we should expect? Example: L5 band top vs requested comp.

djensen: We use published salary bands (People Ops > Compensation > Bands). If the proposed salary is above band top, the packet must include market comp data and approval from VP+ for exception. We try to quota exceptions conservatively.

eli-manager: For leveling disputes: if an IC disagrees with manager leveling, what's the appeals path?

djensen: Escalation goes to the L4 review panel (cross-functional senior ICs), then to People Ops if still unresolved. Document evidence in the packet (work samples, metrics).

sarah-hr: Any tip for writing the justification? Managers often struggle to be specific.

djensen: Keep it behavioral + impact oriented. Use this mini-format: 1) What changed (responsibilities), 2) Tangible impact (metrics or examples), 3) Evidence of consistent performance (>=6 months). One-line headline at top helps reviewers.

laura-eng: Thanks — that's helpful. Last question: once comp is approved, when will managers see the updated offer details?

djensen: After committee sign-off, comp-partner updates the packet and People Ops publishes the change. Managers get an automated note the same day; payroll receives finalized feeds by EOD for effective date processing. Expect 3 business days from sign-off to manager notification in most cases.

eli-manager: Perfect. I'll gather the docs and submit two packets today. :thumbsup:

sarah-hr: Awesome — ping me if you want a quick packet review before submission.

djensen: Thanks all. I'll post the promo checklist and a sample justification in #people-ops pinned doc in 30m.

comp-bot: [automated] Ticket #CMT-874 created for 2026-05-18 comp committee.
